name: OmniAudit MCP
description: A production-grade MCP server offering modules for GitHub issue/PR triage, live website auditing, and automated release note generation. It provides robust security features like write-operation confirmation gates, rate limiting, and dual-read storage backends.

rawRecord.description: A production-grade MCP server offering modules for GitHub issue/PR triage, live website auditing, and automated release note generation. It provides robust security features like write-operation confirmation gates, rate limiting, and dual-read storage backends.

LOG_FORMAT.description: The format for structured logs (json or plain).

OTEL_ENABLED.description: Set to true to enable optional OTLP traces.

MCP_AUTH_MODE.description: Authentication mode for the MCP endpoint (e.g., none, api_key).

S3_ENDPOINT_URL.description: The endpoint URL for S3 or MinIO.

S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID.description: The access key ID for S3/MinIO.

PROMETHEUS_ENABLED.description: Set to true to enable the Prometheus metrics endpoint.

OBJECT_STORE_BUCKET.description: The S3 bucket name to use when OBJECT_STORE_BACKEND is set to s3.

OBJECT_STORE_PREFIX.description: The prefix (path) within the S3 bucket.

S3_FORCE_PATH_STYLE.description: Whether to force path-style URLs for S3/MinIO.

SITELINT_ASYNC_MODE.description: Set to true and run worker service to process scan jobs via Celery.

OBJECT_STORE_BACKEND.description: Storage backend mode (local or s3). Default is local.

S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY.description: The secret access key for S3/MinIO.

OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT.description: The endpoint for the OTLP collector (e.g., http://otel-collector:4318/v1/traces).
